result.summary: This third-party module is a set of six 1x1-pixel test images (black and white, in GIF, JPEG and PNG), apparently used as image-decoding fixtures. I checked the surface for build steps, code or encoded payloads. It holds only tiny binary images whose sizes match minimal valid single-pixel images, and nothing executes.

findings.title: Binary image fixtures only
findings.detail: The unit contains only six tiny binary image files: 1x1 black and white pixels in GIF (35 bytes), JPEG (283–305 bytes) and PNG (88 bytes) format. Their names and sizes fit minimal valid single-pixel images. 35 bytes is the classic minimal 1x1 GIF, and 88 bytes is ordinary for a 1x1 PNG. Files this small cannot plausibly hold a meaningful payload. There is no build script, source code or loader in the unit. In Ghostty they serve as image-decoding test fixtures, e.g. for the wuffs-based image tests.
